market.summary: Wall Street sold off overnight, led by tech (Nasdaq -2.5%), and Asia followed this morning (Nikkei -2.4%, KOSPI -3.6%). GIFT Nifty is roughly flat near 25,290-25,300, so India may open steady, but a weak global tape can hit small and mid caps again after yesterday's 1.1% small-cap fall. Foreign investors' November buying (about $8.9 bn so far) is the main support.

points.text: US close 16 Nov: Dow 51,608 (-1.4%), S&P 500 7,417 (-1.9%), Nasdaq 24,510 (-2.5%); AI stocks weak ahead of Nvidia's results.
